CLOUD_ATB.title: ATB
CLOUD_ATB.description:
Represents combat momentum.

Gain ATB from attacks and effects. 
Attack-based gain is limited by your Max ATB, but other effects may exceed this limit.
Spend ATB to use powerful cards.

You gain 1 ATB at the start of your turn if you have 0 ATB.
CLOUD_LIMIT.title: Limit
CLOUD_LIMIT.description:
Builds as you fight. 

Gain 3 [gold]Limit[/gold] when attacking or blocking attacks. 
Gain [gold]Limit[/gold] equal to damage taken. 

At 100 [gold]Limit[/gold], powerful [gold]Limit Break[/gold] attacks become available. 
After combat, retain 50% of Limit 

Limit is consumed when Limit Break is used.
CLOUD_SUMMON.title: Summon
CLOUD_SUMMON.description:
Builds as you fight. 

Gain 3 Summon when attacking.
Gain 6 Summon when using [gold]Magic[/gold] cards.

At 100 Summon, choose an [gold]Esper[/gold] to call forth.

[gold]Espers[/gold] deal high damage and grant powerful bonuses for 3 turns. 
After combat, retain 50% of Summon 

Summon is consumed after use.
CLOUD_MAGIC.title: Magic
CLOUD_MAGIC.description: This card deals [gold]Magic[/gold] damage and does not get bonus damage from [gold]Punisher Mode[/gold].
CLOUD_STANCE.title: Switch Stance
CLOUD_STANCE.description: Switch stance between [gold]Punisher[/gold] and [gold]Operator Mode[/gold] after using this card.
CLOUD_PUNISHER.title: Punisher Mode
CLOUD_PUNISHER.description: Switch stance to [gold]Punisher Mode[/gold] after using this card.
CLOUD_OPERATOR.title: Operator Mode
CLOUD_OPERATOR.description: Switch stance to [gold]Operator Mode[/gold] after using this card.
